Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: National Digital Strategy includes Government Data Centre and Cloud Plan (SO4 Pillar 3) to ensure critical infrastructure is secure. Draft Data Protection Bill pending. The Civil Registration and Identification Bill includes data protection principles. Government data sovereignty focus noted but enforcement not yet fully established.
redteam_note: Comment wording may not match the score — re-read (needs judgement).
revision_notes: Downgraded from 'strong yet unenforced controls' (3) to 'limited controls' (2). UNECA's digital-trade country profile confirms Namibia has no data protection law, no cross-border data-flow regulation, no data-localisation requirement and no data protection authority. The Data Protection Bill was still 'under final polishing' as of January 2026, and the Cybercrime Bill (Jan 2026 draft), which would designate critical information infrastructure, is also not yet law; the National Digital Strategy references data sovereignty only as an aspiration, not an enforceable control.
